wardrobe.description: Comfortable child outfit suitable for a clinic visit: soft teal hoodie, warm cream T-shirt, beige trousers, and simple blue sneakers; clothing should allow one arm/hand to be visible for the exam without indicating left or right.
forbidden: visible left/right labels or directional symbols on sleeves

wardrobe.description: No clothing; soft plush-like rabbit body with long ears, pink inner ears, small black eyes, quick twitching nose, and expressive paws. Keep the bunny gentle, rounded, and huggable rather than realistic-wild.

mustShow: Child and Bunny together in the clinic waiting area
Colorful animal stickers on the wall
Doctor’s door in the background as the gentle unknown
Bunny’s paws planted bravely despite a tiny tremble
Warm, reassuring color palette with space for title text
coverContract.worldType: Contemporary gentle pediatric clinic world, realistic picture-book style with soft expressive exaggeration for feelings and an animate comforting bunny companion.

forbiddenGlobalElements: crying crowds or extra named people
left/right labels or directional laterality cues

hairStyle.value: medium-length, worn loose in a simple everyday style

anchors.description: A high waiting-room chair that feels oversized to the child.
Colorful animal stickers on the waiting-room wall.
The doctor’s door between the waiting room and exam room; closed at first, then open.
A tall examination chair in the center of the exam room, nicknamed visually as a small mountain.
A low shelf or counter near the exam chair where the bunny can place its paws.
A small drawer in the exam room holding the tiny medical pinch item and a colorful plaster.

locations.description: A clean, calm clinic interior that smells visually of soap and freshness: white walls, soft medical order, colorful animal stickers, and a closed doctor’s door leading from the waiting room into the exam room.
locations.lighting: Clean white clinic light softened for a warm children’s-book mood; no harsh shadows.
locations.name: Pediatric clinic interior
locations.topology: The waiting area connects to the doctor-door threshold, which leads directly into the exam-chair area of the exam room. The exam-chair area connects back toward the clinic exit and outside sunlight.

anchors.description: Clinic entrance or exterior wall behind the characters.
A sunlit path or sidewalk where the child and bunny can move freely.

locations.description: Sunny sidewalk or clinic entrance exterior after the visit, bright and open, giving a sense of release and courage.
locations.lighting: Warm clear sunlight, cheerful and reassuring.
locations.name: Outside the clinic
locations.topology: Outside zone sits beyond the clinic exit, visually contrasting the enclosed exam room with open sunshine.

pageContracts.camera: Medium-wide child-height view that makes the chair and door feel large but not scary.
mustShow: Clean waiting room with white light and a fresh soap-like feeling
Colorful animal stickers on the wall
High waiting-room chair that feels too big
Closed doctor’s door in the background
Child visibly tense, with anxiety suggested by a small subtle balloon-like shape near the belly

propState.state: central and too high for the child

pageContracts.camera: Low, playful under-chair angle focused on Bunny’s first peek-out.
mustShow: Long pink bunny ear peeking from under an adult-sized chair
Small bunny nose emerging and twitching quickly
Bunny soft and sweet but visibly trembling in the knees
Waiting-room stickers and clean white light remain consistent

pageContracts.camera: Two-shot at child height, with the closed door framed behind Bunny.
mustShow: Child whispering to Bunny in the waiting area
Bunny looking toward the closed doctor’s door
Bunny’s hind paws bouncing in place with comic nervous energy
A first hint of humor easing the child’s fear

pageContracts.camera: Doorway composition with waiting room behind and bright exam room ahead; small-step motion across the threshold.
mustShow: Doctor’s door opening into bright exam-room light
Bunny standing and hiding black eyes behind long ears
Warm parental hand offered as reassurance
Child taking tiny brave steps toward the doorway
Movement from waiting room into the unknown shown gently

propState.state: only hinted beyond doorway, not central

transition.cue: The door opens and the child begins entering.

pageContracts.camera: Wide interior reveal of the exam room, with the chair large but rounded and non-threatening.
mustShow: Exam room interior after entering
Tall examination chair centered like a friendly mountain
Bunny on the shelf with two front paws placed flat
Bunny concentrating on keeping paws in place while nose still trembles
Child invited to copy the steady-paws idea

propState.state: behind them or out of focus, open

transition.cue: They are now inside the exam room.

pageContracts.camera: Comforting medium close-up on the stethoscope moment, keeping faces and Bunny visible.
mustShow: Stethoscope with silver circle touching the child gently
Cool, slightly tickly sensation suggested with soft blue sparkle or ripple marks
Child staying on the exam chair
Bunny pressing paws in place and silently counting
Calm medical professional smile after the cold part ends

propState.state: in use with silver circle visible
nearby for Bunny’s paws or implied

pageContracts.camera: Medium shot including the open drawer and Bunny’s reaction, with the medical item kept small in frame.
mustShow: Small drawer opened in the exam room
Tiny medical pinch item shown small and non-threatening inside or near the drawer
Colorful plaster visible with the drawer contents
Bunny genuinely startled with ears flattened back
Bunny’s hind paws dancing nervously in place

propState.state: put away or out of focus

pageContracts.camera: Intimate close-up on Bunny’s paws and the child’s attentive face; background simplified.
mustShow: Close focus on child looking at Bunny
Bunny admitting fear through expression and fast-twitching nose
Bunny lowering two paws onto the chair surface
The two paws visibly trembling but staying planted
Quiet lesson of trembling and staying

propState.state: out of frame or no longer emphasized

pageContracts.camera: Medium shot arranged around the child’s brave choice, parent comfort, and Bunny beside the chair.
mustShow: Child taking a deep breath on the exam chair
One hand or arm offered forward for the procedure without any left/right indication
Other hand holding the parent firmly for comfort without left/right indication
Bunny standing beside the chair with nose trembling and paws staying planted
Calm prepared medical setup kept visually small

pageContracts.camera: Tight but gentle three-quarter view focused on faces, hands, and Bunny; keep the actual pinch discreet.
mustNotShow: bandage already finished at start of scene
mustShow: Counting moment: one, two, three conveyed visually with gentle rhythm
Child’s offered hand or arm trembling slightly without left/right indication
Parent giving a gentle comforting squeeze
Tiny pinch represented as a brief minimal cue, not a graphic close-up
Bunny whispering paws-in-place and staying beside the chair

propState.state: briefly in use, minimized and non-graphic
ready to apply after the pinch

pageContracts.camera: Warm medium close-up on the plaster and Bunny’s comic relief expression.
mustShow: Colorful plaster being placed on the child’s hand or arm without left/right indication
Plaster feels like a tiny flag of 'I stayed' through design or pose, without needing readable text
Bunny making a funny scrunched face as if the pinch reached its nose too
Bunny’s ears popping upward in relief
Shared calm after the difficult moment

propState.state: applied to the child’s hand or arm without laterality

pageContracts.camera: Bright medium-wide outdoor ending shot with open space and warm sunlight.
mustShow: Sunny exterior outside the clinic
Child smiling with decorated plaster visible on a hand or arm without left/right indication
Bunny making a small happy jump
Parent nearby in a calm supportive posture
Open sunlight showing fear remembered but courage learned

propState.state: still applied and visible as a courage badge without laterality

transition.cue: The visit is over and the characters are outside in the sun.
